expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit is supported by an observable the executing pointcloud scalar contains; incumbent retained with explicit fallback.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A to chase the pair-kernel contrast would change the pointcloud curvature, which has no pair-kernel term, so the intended short-shell response would not be produced and surrounding coordinates could be displaced without the targeted effect.

Selecting a single region_index from mixed-sign landmark softmin/occupancy contrasts would overfit one region and ignore the opposite-sign regions, risking unnecessary displacement of surrounding coordinates.

Using temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend would rely on observed-node interpolants that fail the registered curve-fidelity rule, so any time-conditioned response is descriptive and could extrapolate beyond the observed support.
Changing teacher_neighbors would alter the detached nearest-k teacher mixture without evidence that neighbor count is the operative bandwidth, and neighbor count is not a distance bandwidth.
Any temperature proposal would be an interface violation, not a research condition.
rationale: Retain the incumbent. The Analyst's strongest reproducible endpoint signal is the short-range pair-kernel contrast (pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 positive with q<=1e-4 and positive batch fraction 1.0; pair_kernel_7.0 reversed), but the executing pointcloud scalar contains no pair-kernel term (formula_registry diagnostic_limit), so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can be tied to that observable. The permitted edits act on the pointcloud curvature, a single landmark region, teacher count, or a time-conditioned teacher blend; none of these is the pair-kernel shell density, and the Analyst's own increment contrasts (pair_kernel_2.5 +3.96, pair_kernel_7.0 -3.14) disagree in sign with the endpoint contrasts, leaving the direction unresolved. Landmark softmin/occupancy contrasts are mixed in sign across regions with no single supported region, so a region_index edit is not defensible. No supplied continuous contrast passes the curve-fidelity rule (all legendre_runtime_allowed=false, relative_node_rmse 0.386-0.931 vs <=0.35, strong_sign_conflict_nodes up to 15), so temporal_region_index and temporal_teacher_blend edits would rest on descriptive interpolants only. Global centroid effects are null after branch adjustment, and joint-motion diagnostics are negative but are diagnostics, not an operative reward term. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Because no registered bounded edit has a defensible expected advantage over the incumbent under the affinity-first objective, retaining the incumbent is the correct choice; the evidence that would change this decision is a reproducible, branch-adjusted endpoint contrast on an observable that the executing pointcloud scalar actually contains, or a validated time-conditioned fit within the observed support.
